title: Lane write guard misses a cd inside a subshell and lets a lane write into the main checkout
body: `(cd <main> && echo x > src/a.ts)` passes: bashTargets anchors cd at segment start, so after `(` the write resolves inside the worktree (src/hook/scope.ts:227-237, 475-504).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d3-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/hook/scope.ts, test/hook/scope.test.ts
